subject: RW_block_lkj_corr_cholesky node dimension error  / reproducing statistical rethinking book examples

messages.author: f0085bf5ed318bc6
messages.subject: RW_block_lkj_corr_cholesky node dimension error  / reproducing statistical rethinking book examples
parts:
Hi All,


I was trying to see if I can reproduce some of the examples in McElreath’s Statistical Rethinking using Nimble, and I’m somewhat struggling with something rather basic using the new dlkj_corr_cholesky() for a varying slope and intercept model. The example below is adapted from section 13.1 in the first edition of statistical rethinking, and returns the following error message:


“Error in samplerFunction(model = model, mvSaved = mvSaved, target = target,  :                                                                                

  RW_block_lkj_corr_cholesky sampler requires target node dimension to be at least 2x2.”


What I’m struggling to get here is that `Ustar` does have a dimension of 2x2, so not really sure why I’m getting this error… 


Any help is greatly appreciated. As a side note, does anyone know if there has been any attempt to have NIMBLE translation of statistical rethinking (in the same vibe of this and this?)


All Best,

Enrico



#Simulate Data ----

a  <- 3.5

b  <- (-1)

sigma_a  <- 1

sigma_b  <- 0.5

rho  <- (-0.7)

Mu  <- c(a,b)

cov_ab  <- sigma_a * sigma_b *rho

Sigma  <- matrix(c(sigma_a^2,cov_ab,cov_ab,sigma_b^2),ncol=2)

N_cafes  <- 20

set.seed(5)

vary_effects  <- MASS::mvrnorm(N_cafes,Mu,Sigma)

a_cafe  <- vary_effects[,1]

b_cafe  <- vary_effects[,2]

N_visits  <- 10

afternoon  <- rep(0:1,N_visits*N_cafes/2)

cafe_id  <- rep(1:N_cafes,each=N_visits)

mu  <- a_cafe[cafe_id] + b_cafe[cafe_id]*afternoon

sigma  <- 0.5

wait  <- rnorm(N_cafes*N_visits,mu,sigma)


#Analysis in Nimble ----

library(nimble)

# Data & Constants

d  <- list()

d$wait  <- wait

constants  <- list()

constants$afternoon  <- afternoon

constants$n  <- length(wait)

constants$n.cafe  <- N_cafes

constants$cafe.id  <- cafe_id


# Custom Function

uppertri_mult_diag <- nimbleFunction(run = function(mat = double(2), vec = double(1)) 

    {

    returnType(double(2))

    p <- length(vec)

    out <- matrix(nrow = p, ncol = p, init = FALSE)

    for(i in 1:p)

    out[ , i] <- mat[ , i] * vec[i]

    return(out)

    })


# Core Model

mod  <- nimbleCode({

for (i in 1:n)

{

wait[i] ~ dnorm(mean=mu.cafe[cafe.id[i]],sd=sigma)

}


for (j in 1:n.cafe)

{

mu.cafe[j]  <- alpha.beta[j,1] + alpha.beta[j,2] * afternoon[j]

alpha.beta[j,1:2] ~ dmnorm(mu[1:2],cholesky=U[1:2,1:2],prec_param=0)

}



sigma ~ dexp(1)

mu[1] ~ dnorm(0,10)

mu[2] ~ dnorm(0,10)

sds[1] ~ dexp(1)

sds[2] ~ dexp(1)

Ustar[1:2,1:2] ~ dlkj_corr_cholesky(2,2)

U[1:2,1:2] <- uppertri_mult_diag(Ustar[1:2, 1:2], sds[1:2])

})


# Simulate Data from model and assign as Inits

sim.model <- nimbleModel(mod,constants=constants)

sim.model$simulate('Ustar')

sim.model$simulate('sds')

sim.model$simulate('U')

sim.model$simulate('mu')

sim.model$simulate('sigma')

sim.model$simulate('alpha.beta')

sim.model$simulate('mu.cafe')

sim.model$simulate('wait')

inits   <- list()

inits$U  <- sim.model$U

inits$Ustar  <- sim.model$Ustar

inits$sds  <- sim.model$sds

inits$mu  <- sim.model$mu

inits$sigma  <- sim.model$sigma

inits$alpha.beta  <- sim.model$alpha.beta

inits$mu.cafe  <- sim.model$mu.cafe



# Run MCMC

model  <- nimbleModel(mod,constants=constants,data=d,inits=inits)

cModel <- compileNimble(model)

conf <- configureMCMC(model)

MCMC <- buildMCMC(conf) #this produces the error


cMCMC <- compileNimble(MCMC)

results <- runMCMC(cMCMC, nchain=4,niter = 50000, thin=5, nburnin = 25000,samplesAsCodaMCMC = T) 

fit  <- nimbleMCMC(mod,constants=constants,data=d,inits=inits,nchains=4,niter=10000,nburnin=5000,samplesAsCodaMCMC = TRUE)

Hi Enrico,

I think you may be using an older version of nimble. In version 0.12.2 we fixed a bug related to sampling 2x2 matrices in such cases.
So please try upgrading to 0.13.1, the current version.

-Chris
